## Goal

Run the existing 121 DB tests on every PR and add a minimal e2e suite for the flows that protect money and trust.

## Context

Verified 2026-11-27: `migrate`, `auth:migrate`, `seed`, `test:db` pass 121/121 on local Postgres 16. Not in CI today.

## Scope

- New CI job `db` with `postgres:16` service.
- Playwright (justify dependency) with the smoke list from `docs/TESTING.md`; leak tests become active when SC-008 lands.
- Update `docs/TESTING.md`.

## Out of scope

- Live provider tests in CI.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `db` job green on the PR.
- [ ] e2e job green against a production build.
- [ ] No test reaches a real provider or a shared database.

## Required tests

- The new jobs themselves.

## Dependencies

- SC-003
